items.title: Bill Huntington and Charlie Suhor Interview, 1992-04-06
items.q: played with a guy by the name of Joe Burton

ctx.x: I'll tell you what, you talked about the Playboy Club and working in the VIP lounge with Al and whatnot, but maybe fill us in on some of your more recent activities since then. I remember the health department closed the Playboy Club down in the mid-70s with 74 or something like that.

Right after that, I went on the road with Jack Jones playing bass. Well, during the interim when I played guitar, like I switched over to the six-string guitar, played six-string guitar for many years, played with a guy by the name of Joe Burton, who Charlie,
I'm sure, remembers. Oh my gosh, yes.
